# Project Graph: Task Tracker

## Issue: Task Tracker Application

### Feature: Add a task
- **Description**: Users can add a new task to their list
- **Acceptance**: Task appears in the list after creation

### Feature: List tasks
- **Description**: Users can view all their tasks
- **Acceptance**: All tasks are displayed in order

### Feature: Complete a task
- **Description**: Users can mark a task as complete
- **Acceptance**: Completed tasks are visually distinguished
